source.citation: Ma, W., & de la Torre, J. (2020). GDINA: An R Package for Cognitive Diagnosis Modeling. Journal of Statistical Software, 93(14), 1-26.
source.note: Published simulation: 1000 examinees by 10 dichotomous items and a 10-by-3 Q-matrix (3 attributes). Components are simdat, simQ, and simItempar. The GDINA vignette builds a different Q around simdat for a walkthrough; this fixture uses the package object's simQ, not that vignette matrix.
